scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c blue,green "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w server && npm run typecheck -w client && npm run typecheck -w client3d
scripts.build: npm run build -w client && npm run build -w client3d
scripts.dev:3d: concurrently -n server,client3d -c blue,magenta "npm run dev -w server" "npm run dev -w client3d"
